name: Omocha no Sensei Nawa Midori
original_name: おもちゃの先生 那波みどり
source:
Main character moves into a studio apartment owned by uncle. But uncle dies very soon, and protagonist has to deal with the monitor system established at the flat. He turns the system on and sees sleeping woman in the next room. The next day he recognizes his new teacher in the sleeping neighbor...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
